services.title: Single-Sitting Root Canal Therapy
services.description: Ergonomic rotary endodontic treatment eliminating toothache in a single session while safeguarding your natural tooth root and structural vitality.
services.idealFor: Acute pulpitis, deep decay, broken tooth ache

services.title: Ceramic & Zirconia Aesthetic Crowns
services.description: Precision milled tooth-colored ceramic crowns and bridges that seamlessly restore biting strength, smile harmony, and root protection.
services.idealFor: Post-root canal teeth, worn enamel, missing tooth gaps

services.title: Cardiac-Safe Atraumatic Extractions
services.description: Gentle sectional tooth extractions utilizing cardiac-appropriate local anesthesia and blood-pressure monitoring for complete peace of mind.
services.idealFor: Hypertensive patients, impacted roots, non-restorable teeth

services.title: Ultrasonic Scaling & Gum Prophylaxis
services.description: Gentle ultrasonic cleaning removing calcified tartar and bacterial biofilm from gum margins to prevent systemic inflammation and gum bleeding.
services.idealFor: Plaque accumulation, bleeding gums, routine half-yearly care

services.title: Composite Tooth-Colored Restorations
services.description: High-grade nano-hybrid composite fillings that chemically bond to natural enamel, arresting decay while matching your exact tooth shade.
services.idealFor: Cavities, chipped front teeth, minor tooth wear

services.title: Custom Flexible Partial Dentures
services.description: Lightweight, unbreakable flexible dentures designed to replace missing teeth comfortably without rigid metal clasps or gum irritation.
services.idealFor: Multiple missing teeth, replacement of heavy acrylic plates
